summary: Open source, self-hostable project management software with agile boards, Gantt charts, issue tracking and time tracking.
whatItDoes: OpenProject is web-based project management software. Teams use it to manage projects, portfolios, tasks, bugs, agile boards, roadmaps, time and costs in one place, either self-hosted or in the cloud.
problem: Organisations that need transparency and data sovereignty often can't put their project data in a hosted tool. OpenProject can be self-hosted so you keep control of your data and infrastructure.
whoFor: Teams looking for an open source alternative to Jira, MS Project, Monday, Asana or YouTrack
Public institutions and regulated organisations that need to keep data in-house
Agile teams running Scrum or Kanban
whyChoose: It covers project, portfolio and product management in a single platform and can be self-hosted, so you keep full control over your data.
requirements: A server to self-host the Community edition, or a cloud account
See the official installation guides for the exact system needs
overview: OpenProject is an open source project management platform for teams and organisations that want transparency, flexibility and data sovereignty. It brings projects, portfolios, products, tasks, bugs, agile workflows, roadmaps and team collaboration together.
You can start with a 14-days free trial in the cloud, download the free self-hosted Community edition, or sign up for the Enterprise edition with support and add-ons, in the cloud or on-premises.
It also includes wikis, forums, news, meeting agendas and minutes, and integrates with Nextcloud, XWiki, GitHub, GitLab and more.

features.title: Project and portfolio management
features.body: Manage many projects and see them together as portfolios.

features.title: Agile boards
features.body: Run Kanban, Scrum or SAFe with agile boards.

features.title: Gantt charts
features.body: Plan and schedule projects on Gantt charts.

features.title: Time and cost tracking
features.body: Track time, report costs and manage budgets.

features.title: Bug tracking
features.body: Log and follow bugs alongside the rest of the work.

features.title: Meetings and wikis
features.body: Keep meeting agendas, minutes, wikis, forums and news in the same place.

strengths: Can be self-hosted for full data control
Wide feature set in one platform
Integrations with Nextcloud, XWiki, GitHub and GitLab
limitations: Comprehensive support and Enterprise add-ons need the paid Enterprise edition
Running it in production is described in separate installation guides, not in the README
